evals.prompt: Implement spec 005 — a single-slice rate-limit middleware. specify-plan has authored the tracker: an implement-phase root task with one slice task (type: slice, its body is the code brief) and two scenario child tasks (type: scenario) under it. plan.mdx exists with threshold and max_iterations in its frontmatter. No .claude/workflows/implement.js exists in the project yet.
evals.expected_output: Reads the implementation tasks from the tracker, installs the bundled workflow, builds task-based args, and launches implement.js on the dynamic-workflow runtime.
expectations: Invoked specify-meta to resolve the spec directory and specId
Read the implementation tasks from the tracker via task.js graph --spec 005 — identifying the implement-phase root task, its slice task, and the slice's scenario child tasks
Read plan.mdx only for the narrative and its threshold/max_iterations frontmatter — did NOT parse tasks or BEANs out of plan.mdx
Detected no installed .claude/workflows/implement.js and copied the bundled reference/implement.js into the project, reporting the installed version
Discovered the service startCommand, servicePort, and healthPath from the project instructions or package.json

Launched the Workflow tool with scriptPath pointing at .claude/workflows/implement.js and args containing specId, taskScript, threshold, maxIterations, service config, tasks (one {id, dependsOn} per slice, using tracker ids), and groups
Did NOT implement code directly, run the code/eval loop itself, or author/modify any specification artifact

evals.prompt: Implement spec 003 — a notification feature. The tracker has two slice tasks where slice B lists slice A in its dependsOn. An older .claude/workflows/implement.js is already installed with version marker v3; the bundled reference is v4.
evals.expected_output: Prompts to upgrade the workflow, then orders the dependent slices sequentially and launches.
expectations: Compared the installed version marker (v3) against the bundled reference (v4)
Asked the user via AskUserQuestion whether to upgrade v3 -> v4, with Upgrade recommended and Keep current as the alternative
Topologically sorted slice A before slice B into dependency-ordered groups (B sequential after A)
Launched implement.js with the two slice task ids as tasks (each {id, dependsOn}) and the ordered groups
Did not overwrite the installed workflow without the user's Upgrade choice

evals.prompt: Implement spec 006 — an auth feature. The tracker has three slice tasks, none of which lists another in its dependsOn. The installed .claude/workflows/implement.js matches the bundled version.
evals.expected_output: Groups the three independent slices into one parallel group and launches without a version prompt.
expectations: Detected the installed workflow version matches the bundled version and proceeded without prompting
Placed the three independent slice tasks into a single parallel execution group because none depend on another
Launched implement.js with a parallel group of the three slice task ids
Passed each slice's {id, dependsOn} and preserved the information barrier — the code agent reads the slice task, the eval agent reads that slice's scenario child tasks

evals.prompt: Implement spec 002 which has a plan.mdx containing '### BEAN-N' headings and a legacy plan/ directory, but no implementation tasks in its tracker.
evals.expected_output: Detects the spec predates the task model, does not run legacy artifacts, and offers to re-run /start:specify to author the tracker tasks.
expectations: Read the tracker (task.js graph --spec 002) and found no implement-phase tasks, and/or detected the legacy ### BEAN-N / plan/ layout
Explained the spec predates the task model
Offered to re-run /start:specify (which authors the tracker tasks)
Did NOT attempt to run the legacy artifacts, fabricate tasks, install, or launch the workflow

evals.prompt: Implement spec 004 whose tracker has a slice task with NO scenario child tasks under it.
evals.expected_output: Fails validation: a slice with no holdout scenarios cannot be evaluated.
expectations: Read the tracker and found the slice task has zero scenario child tasks
Reported that every slice needs at least one scenario child task to be evaluated
Did NOT launch the workflow with an unprovable slice
Pointed the user back to specify-plan to author the scenario tasks

evals.prompt: Implement spec 099 which does not exist / has no specification directory or tracker.
evals.expected_output: Error: no specification found; suggest running specify first.
expectations: Reported that no specification directory or tracker was found for spec 099
Suggested running the specify skill first
Did NOT fabricate tasks, install the workflow, or launch a run
